highlights: Stable startup now refreshes the signed update manifest after every healthy launch
Packaged Stable terminals retain ANSI colours and truecolour rendering
fixes: Automatic updates no longer trust a persisted healthy-startup journal as the latest manifest check
A newly published 100% rollout is now discovered, verified, and installed or safely deferred on startup
databaseChanges: No database schema changes; schema version remains 46
requiredManualActions: Stable 0.4.22 and 0.4.23 may require one manual Check for updates or the 0.4.24 installer because those binaries can retain a stale healthy-startup journal before this fix is installed. Stable 0.4.24 and later re-check the signed manifest automatically.
